metadata.label: Single Volume (SNGLVOL)
metadata.description: Single thermal-hydraulic control volume with two-phase phasic mass and energy balance.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.1

metadata.label: Time-Dependent Volume (TMDPVOL)
metadata.description: Boundary-condition hydrodynamic volume prescribing time-dependent pressure, temperature, and quality.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.2

metadata.label: Pipe Component (PIPE)
metadata.description: One-dimensional multi-node hydrodynamic pipe with Darcy-Weisbach wall friction and elevation head.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.3; Todreas & Kazimi Ch. 9

metadata.label: Annulus Component (ANNULUS)
metadata.description: Annular flow channel specialized for reactor vessel downcomer counter-current flooding and entrainment.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.4

metadata.label: Branch Component (BRANCH)
metadata.description: Single hydrodynamic volume with up to nine attached junctions for plena, tees, and headers.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.5

metadata.label: Single Junction (SNGLJUN)
metadata.description: Single momentum junction connecting two hydrodynamic volumes with form losses and homogeneous choked flow.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.6

parameters.description: Isentropic expansion exponent for choked flow

metadata.label: Time-Dependent Junction (TMDPJUN)
metadata.description: Boundary-condition junction prescribing phasic mass flow rate or velocity as a function of time.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.7

parameters.description: Isentropic expansion exponent for choked flow

metadata.label: Centrifugal Pump (PUMP)
metadata.description: Single- and two-phase centrifugal coolant pump with homologous head and torque curves.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.9

metadata.label: Trip Valve (VALVE_TRIP)
metadata.description: Abruptly opening or closing trip-actuated isolation valve with homogeneous choked flow limit.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.8.1

parameters.description: Isentropic expansion exponent for choked flow

metadata.label: Motor-Operated Valve (VALVE_MOTOR)
metadata.description: Rate-limited motor-operated valve with linear stroke time and choked orifice flow.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.8.3

parameters.description: Isentropic expansion exponent for choked flow

metadata.label: Check Valve (VALVE_CHECK)
metadata.description: Static/dynamic swing check valve permitting forward flow and blocking reverse backflow.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.8.2

parameters.description: Isentropic expansion exponent for choked flow
Minimum forward differential pressure to open

metadata.label: Safety / Relief Valve (VALVE_RELIEF)
metadata.description: Spring-loaded safety or power-operated relief valve opening above setpoint pressure with choked discharge.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.8.5

parameters.description: Isentropic expansion exponent for choked flow

metadata.label: Steam Turbine Stage (TURBINE)
metadata.description: Impulse/reaction steam turbine stage computing isentropic enthalpy drop and mechanical shaft power.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.12

metadata.label: Steam-Water Separator (SEPARATOR)
metadata.description: Mechanistic steam-water separator partitioning two-phase inlet mixture into dry steam and saturated liquid return.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.10

metadata.label: ECCS Accumulator (ACCUM)
metadata.description: Nitrogen-pressurized passive emergency core cooling accumulator with polytropic gas expansion.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I (RELAP5/MOD3.3 Code Manual), Section 3.13

metadata.label: PWR Pressurizer (PRIZER)
metadata.description: Two-region non-equilibrium PWR pressurizer with proportional heaters, spray condensation, and surge line.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I; Todreas & Kazimi, Nuclear Systems I, Ch. 5

metadata.label: Nuclear Fuel Rod Heat Structure (HTSTR_FUEL_ROD)
metadata.description: Cylindrical UO2 pellet, helium gap, and Zircaloy cladding radial heat conduction structure.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I, Section 4.1; Todreas & Kazimi, Nuclear Systems I, Ch. 8

parameters.description: Outer cladding heat transfer surface area

metadata.label: Steam Generator U-Tube Heat Structure (HTSTR_SG_TUBE)
metadata.description: Inconel-690/600 steam generator U-tube wall conducting heat from primary RCS to secondary boiling side.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I, Section 4.1; Todreas & Kazimi, Nuclear Systems I, Ch. 8

parameters.description: Outer heat transfer surface area per tube

metadata.label: Dittus-Boelter Convection Correlation (CORR_DITTUS_BOELTER)
metadata.description: Turbulent single-phase forced convection correlation Nu = 0.023 * Re^0.8 * Pr^0.4 (heating) or Pr^0.3 (cooling).
metadata.provenance: Dittus & Boelter (1930); Winterton (1998), Int. J. Heat Mass Transfer 41, 809-810; NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. IV

metadata.label: Chen Saturated Boiling Correlation (CORR_CHEN_BOILING)
metadata.description: Superposition of macroscopic forced convection (F * h_mac) and suppressed microscopic nucleate boiling (S * h_mic).
metadata.provenance: Chen, J. C. (1966), Ind. Eng. Chem. Process Des. Dev. 5(3), 322-329; US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. IV

metadata.label: Zuber Pool-Boiling CHF Correlation (CORR_ZUBER_CHF)
metadata.description: Hydrodynamic Taylor/Helmholtz instability pool-boiling critical heat flux q''_CHF = 0.131 * h_fg * rho_g^0.5 * [sigma * g * (rho_f - rho_g)]^0.25.
metadata.provenance: Zuber, N. (1959), Hydrodynamic Aspects of Boiling Heat Transfer, AECU-4439; Todreas & Kazimi Ch. 13

metadata.label: Groeneveld CHF Look-Up Correlation (CORR_GROENEVELD_CHF)
metadata.description: AECL-UO Groeneveld critical heat flux correlation with diameter correction (8 mm reference tube) for PWR/BWR channels.
metadata.provenance: Groeneveld, D. C. et al. (2007), Nuclear Engineering and Design 237, 1909-1922; NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. IV

parameters.description: Reference 8 mm tube CHF at nominal P, G, x
Look-up table reference tube diameter (8 mm)

metadata.label: 6-Group Point Reactor Kinetics (POINT_KINETICS_6G)
metadata.description: Six-delayed-neutron-precursor-group point reactor kinetics equations integrated via 2nd-order Heun RK2.
metadata.provenance: US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I, Section 6.1; Keepin (1965) U-235 thermal fission delayed neutron constants

metadata.label: ANS-5.1-1979 Decay Heat Model (DECAY_HEAT_ANS79)
metadata.description: Fission product decay heat power fraction P_d(t)/P_0 after reactor shutdown for U-235 thermal fission.
metadata.provenance: ANSI/ANS-5.1-1979 (Decay Heat Power in Light Water Reactors); US NRC NUREG/CR-5535 Vol. I, Section 6.2

parameters.description: Pre-shutdown steady operating thermal power P0
Prior full-power irradiation duration T_op (default 1 yr)

metadata.label: IAPWS-IF97 Water/Steam Saturation Table (STEAM_IAPWS_IF97)
metadata.description: Exact IAPWS-IF97 Region 4 backward saturation temperature T_sat(P) over 611.213 Pa to 22.064 MPa.
metadata.provenance: IAPWS-IF97 (Wagner et al., J. Eng. Gas Turbines Power 122, 150-182, 2000), Region 4 Eq. (31)
